title: Pat Price remote views denied Soviet sites with gores and steel spheres

tellings.quote: not only reported on them with accuracy he talked about machinery and stuff there like a big Tower

plain: In the early 1970s, a psychic named Pat Price, working in a US government programme on remote viewing, meaning the claimed ability to describe distant places using only the mind, is said to have described secret Soviet sites accurately, including machinery, a big tower and large steel spheres. Joe McMoneagle, an Army officer who later became a remote viewer in the same programme, tells this as something he learned about Price's work. If true, it would mean the mind can gather spy information from places no one could visit.
